0.why: SlewCore.cc:20 takes the voice count from this jack and SlewCore.cc:31 slews each voice separately
SlewCore.cc:23 sets this output's channel count from the input jack

comment: No family is set on either jack: the maker's manual calls the input CV or audio. The two knobs are configured over 1 to 2000 ms (Slew_info.hh:19-20) and that is what the tooltip displays, but SlewCore.cc:41 and SlewCore.cc:45 map the parameter as though it arrived over 0 to 5, while the host hands it over 0 to 1 (comm_module.cc:14). The knob therefore reaches only 400.8ms. The manual's '1ms - 2sec' repeats the configured range, not the one in use.
